newsitem.title: USA: PacifiCorp, Northwest Natgas in marketing alliance.
newsitem.headline: PacifiCorp, Northwest Natgas in marketing alliance.

text.p: PacifiCorp and Northwest Natural Gas Co announced Thursday plans to form an alliance to market gas and energy services, and eventually electricity, to commercial and industrial customers in Oregon and Washington.
They said the alliance is aimed at meeting the multiple fuel needs of customers, who are already able to choose their gas supplier.
The companies will offer gas commodity and energy services immediately throughout Oregon and Washington.
In the future, they will also offer electric commodity in the areas of those two states where utilities offer pilot programs allowing large customers to choose their electricity supplier.
Fred Buckman, chief executive officer of PacifiCorp, said in a statement the alliance allows the companies to join strengths without losing autonomy and without the delays of a merger.
